history.summary: Popular Shiva temple near Sardar Patel Bridge on NH-48 at Sanskar Bunglows, Vadadla, Bharuch-392011, on the banks of the Narmada with ghat steps leading to the river. The complex has a central Nilkantheshwar Mahadev shrine (locally said to be swayambhu - verify), a Hanuman shrine opposite, and a second Shiva shrine; special religious programmes are organised in Shravan. NOTE ON IDENTITY: despite the CSV 'historic' hint, no source gives the temple any ancient history, patron dynasty, or built date - treat as a modern temple of uncertain antiquity (provisional). Coordinates are approximate (near the Sardar Patel Bridge area). CSV STATE FLAG: the CSV 'state' column holds the town name - this temple is in GUJARAT (Bharuch district).

name: Nilkantheshwar Mahadev Temple
town_description: Bharuch is an ancient river-port city on the Narmada in south Gujarat (ancient Bhrigukachchha), a district headquarters and industrial centre. The Nilkantheshwar temple stands on the river's western bank near the Sardar Patel Bridge, a well-known local spot for peaceful darshan and river views.
